text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up our seemingly long, yet brief
three-year voyage with Tap Dance City--

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Man, that's awesome, totally the best!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—We're lost!
What a thrilling phrase!
choice_data_list: (You're probably the only one who'd be happy about getting lost...)
(You're probably the only one who'd be happy about getting lost...)

text_block_list.text: The story goes back a little while before that—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer!
Hand over that hot springs ticket I had you hold on to!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Once our dream comes true,
I wanna sit down and have a long talk with you.

Come to think of it, I recall being told they wanted to have an open-hearted talk.
In that case, it sounds like it'll be a leisurely journey, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry up!
Strike while the iron is hot, isn't that what they say where you're from!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, suddenly on guard, are we?!
So you already know, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Time to set sail! Right now! To the hot springs!

...I had a feeling it would turn out like this.
Whenever you're with Tap Dance City,
there's no time to just relax.
choice_data_list: Wait, let me check the route—
Wait, let me check the route—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No.
I'm not relying on your guidance this time.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to guide the way!
I have a plan, so follow me!

"...And so, despite a slight sense of foreboding,
I followed along after her—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Let's ride like the wind!
...Yeah, I guess that's not gonna work!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I still think crossing the sea by boat
was a pretty nice idea, though.

Unfortunately, reaching the hot spring inn doesn't require
crossing the sea at all. If I leave it to her,
we probably won't get there today.
choice_data_list: (I'd better look into other avenues after all...)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Trainer.
Don't look so anxious!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to get you to your destination.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come, follow me!
Toward an uncharted oasis—our journey begins!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"—I reckon there's a path waiting once we climb this cliff!
Come on, get your footing!"
choice_data_list: I can see stairs over there, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? I CAN'T HEAR A THING.
...Climbing it will be way more fun! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Stepping stones ahead!
Give me your hand, I'll escort you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Put a bit more weight on this side!
Don't worry. I can easily support one person!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
Run, full sprint ahead--!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Because the sun is setting, obviously! There's bound to be an oasis beyond here! GO!!
And so, aiming for the hot spring inn with Tap Dance City, we overcame various hardships—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —...I-I made it...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So this is the forbidden fountain!
An oasis...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you worked hard, Trainer!
Go take a nice, relaxing bath!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――Much better!
Man, that was a great bath!

"After soaking in the hot spring, Tap Dance City
invited me out for a stroll around the area."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We used our bodies a lot today,
so that really hit the spot, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha!
I've never seen you make a face like that before."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's a good look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for dragging you around today.
Still, I'm satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Because we were able to have an honest, heart-to-heart talk.

I've been running around with her all day,
and I feel like this is the first time today
we've actually sat down to talk face-to-face...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"My Navigator
is wise and rational."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's not easy to show who you really are beneath the surface, is it?
Especially to someone you're supposed to be guiding.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yet today we ran so much,
jumped, and sometimes solved things hand in hand...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I could see your face clearly.
I was able to converse with what lies even deeper in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to properly...
become a part of your "crew."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I like you.
There's no one else I'd rather share my dreams with!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, put your arm around my shoulder!
I want to talk closer tonight.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"My treasure――
Let's celebrate the miracle of our meeting!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh, that star... catches my eye.
Feels like there's an unseen treasure waiting beneath it.
choice_data_list: ...Hold on, let me check the route.
...Wait, let me look up the route.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'm counting on you, Trainer!

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Tap Dance City...
